content.value_statement: Teams often lose context for system design and technical decisions. This skill creates structured architecture documents, ADRs, diagrams, and review guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates system architecture document outlines with context, components, data, infrastructure, and security sections.
Drafts Architecture Decision Records with context, decision, alternatives, consequences, and status.
Suggests diagram types for system context, deployment, data flow, sequence, and component views.
Documents scalability, reliability, observability, security, and deployment considerations.
Provides maintenance practices for keeping architecture documentation aligned with code changes.
limitations: Does not inspect code automatically unless the user provides repository access or relevant files.
Does not verify cloud infrastructure, production topology, or live service configuration.
Does not replace security, compliance, or architecture review by qualified stakeholders.
Requires accurate project context to avoid generic or incomplete documentation.

use_cases.title: Create a System Architecture Document
use_cases.description: Turn system context, services, data stores, integrations, and deployment notes into a clear architecture reference.

use_cases.title: Record Technical Decisions
use_cases.description: Capture why a technology, pattern, or migration path was chosen, including alternatives and trade-offs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Onboarding Documentation
use_cases.description: Summarize system boundaries, workflows, diagrams, and operational concerns for new team members.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Architecture Overview
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a first architecture draft for an existing project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a system architecture overview for this project. Include purpose, users, main components, data stores, integrations, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Component And Data Flow Document
prompt_templates.scenario: You have service and database details and need a deeper document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Document the architecture for these components and data flows. Include responsibilities, dependencies, failure modes, diagrams to create, and assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Architecture Decision Record
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to explain a major technical decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an ADR for this decision. Include context, decision, alternatives considered, consequences, risks, mitigation, rollout plan, and review date.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Architecture Review Pack
prompt_templates.scenario: You need documentation for a design review or migration review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture review pack. Cover current state, target state, diagrams, scalability, security, observability, migration steps, risks, and unresolved decisions.

output_examples.input: Document a payments service that uses a web app, API gateway, payment provider, database, and webhook processor.
output_examples.output: A structured architecture document with system context, component responsibilities, webhook flow, payment security notes, failure handling, and recommended diagrams.

output_examples.input: Write an ADR for moving from server sessions to JWT authentication.
output_examples.output: An ADR with accepted status, context, decision, alternatives, consequences, token security concerns, rollout plan, and rollback guidance.

output_examples.input: Update architecture docs before a microservices migration review.
output_examples.output: A review-ready outline covering current dependencies, target service boundaries, data ownership, deployment changes, observability, risks, and decision gaps.

best_practices: Provide real system context, constraints, and known trade-offs before asking for documentation.
Ask for diagrams as descriptions first, then convert them into your team's preferred diagram format.
Review generated ADRs with engineering, security, product, and operations stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated architecture documents without checking them against the actual system.
Do not hide uncertainty; mark assumptions, unknowns, and decisions that still need review.
Do not use architecture documentation as a substitute for threat modeling or compliance review.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create system architecture documents, ADRs, diagram plans, deployment notes, and documentation maintenance guidance.

faq.question: Can it analyze my repository automatically?
faq.answer: It can use repository files when the assistant has access, but the skill itself is documentation guidance, not a scanner.

faq.question: Does it generate diagrams?
faq.answer: It recommends diagram types and content. You can ask the assistant to format diagrams in Mermaid, PlantUML, or another tool.

faq.question: Is it useful for Architecture Decision Records?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ADR structure covering context, decision, alternatives, consequences, risks, and rollout planning.

faq.question: Who should review the output?
faq.answer: Technical leads, system owners, security reviewers, operations teams, and product stakeholders should review relevant sections.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide components, data stores, integrations, deployment details, constraints, known risks, and the audience for the document.
